title: Head of Production, Supply Chain & Continuous Improvement
text:
At Alloy Precision Technologies, we unite advanced manufacturing with hands-on mastery to deliver for our customers—and create meaningful growth for our people. Lead the engine room of our business and amplify impact across operations.

**Your mission**
----------------

* Own the production, supply chain, maintenance, planning, and warehouse ecosystem—drive flow, reliability, and cost discipline.
* Build systems that make performance visible: schedule adherence, on-time delivery, throughput, and quality.
* Elevate safety and environmental performance through visible leadership and clear standards.
* Institutionalize lean practices and business process improvements that reduce waste and improve profitability.
* Publish clear, actionable reports that inform decisions across the organization.
* Set annual targets and programs for manufacturing, service, and distribution that align with strategy.
* Ensure outcomes meet customer expectations and comply with AS9100 and applicable regulations.
* Travel domestically and internationally as required to support operations and partner engagements.
* Take on additional priorities as assigned by the President and Chief Executive Officer.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Plan, coordinate, and control day-to-day operations across all manufacturing services.
* Diagnose and resolve production delays and constraints via structured problem solving.
* Strengthen cross-functional communication to align objectives and remove friction.
* Coach and mentor leaders; cultivate a culture of empowerment, accountability, and teamwork.

**Team leadership**
-------------------

* Directly lead group leaders, supply chain, and production planning; adapt org structure as needs evolve.
* Execute people processes in accordance with APT policies and all applicable laws: hiring, training, work assignment, performance management, recognition, discipline, issue resolution, and career growth.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BS in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years in manufacturing management; exposure to precision welding (TIG, laser, brazing, soldering), CNC/manual machining, and light assembly is beneficial.
* Advanced skills with Microsoft Office; experience with databases/ERP (e.g., Visual Manufacturing) and establishing labor standards for cost models is advantageous.
* High-energy, results-driven leadership with exceptional interpersonal skills; able to influence at every level.
* Strategic, proactive, and persistent; effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
* Flexible, resilient, and growth-oriented within an evolving culture; dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated lean manufacturing capability required; Six Sigma background is a plus.

degree.text: BS in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
